post.summary: Trigger CIBIL bureau report generation for a given date
Reschedule loan EMI
post.description:
Reschedule the loan based on the provided reason:
- PREPAYMENT_RECALC: After partial prepayment, reduce EMI or tenure.
- RATE_CHANGE: Revise interest rate (MCLR/RLLR reset, regulatory change).
- TENURE_EXTENSION: Extend remaining tenure to lower EMI burden.
- TENURE_REDUCTION: Shorten tenure by increasing EMI.
- MORATORIUM: Grant payment holiday (regulatory / hardship relief).
- RESTRUCTURING: Full NPA restructure — capitalise arrears, fresh schedule.
- EMI_AMOUNT_CHANGE: Override EMI directly; tenure recomputed.
- EMI_DATE_CHANGE: Shift monthly due day-of-month (1–28); EMI/tenure unchanged.

post.summary: Preview EMI reschedule (dry-run)
post.description:
Computes the projected outcome of a reschedule without persisting anything.
Returns the same before/after summary as the apply endpoint plus the full
projected amortization schedule so the user can review before committing.

post.summary: Process EMI payment or prepayment
post.description: Allocates payment per RBI waterfall: Penal Charges → Charges → Penal Interest → Interest → Principal

post.summary: Reverse a payment transaction
post.description: Only REPAYMENT and PREPAYMENT transactions can be reversed. Restores all balances and schedule statuses.

post.summary: Preview payment allocation (dry-run)
post.description: Simulates RBI waterfall allocation and shows how the payment would be applied. Nothing is saved.

post.summary: Preview prepayment (dry-run)
post.description: Returns projected waterfall breakdown and revised amortization schedule. Nothing is saved.

post.summary: Unified payment (auto-classified)
post.description: Single endpoint for all non-foreclosure payments. System classifies as REPAYMENT or PREPAYMENT based on amount vs current demand.

post.summary: Preview unified payment (dry-run)
post.description: Returns classification, waterfall breakdown, and (when prepayment) revised schedule. Nothing is saved.

post.summary: Process foreclosure payment
post.description: Must match the amount from a valid (non-expired) foreclosure quote

Record LOS fee/charge transfer
post.description:
Marks origination charges (processing fee, documentation fee, etc.) as collected
by the LOS. Each entry is matched by chargeType to an unsettled LMS charge and
immediately settled. A discount field records any waiver given during origination.
